newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average drops more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average drops more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 50 points in late afternoon trading Thursday as the market was pressured for a second straight day by profit taking after romping to a record close on Tuesday.
At 3:05 p.m. EDT, the Dow was off 50.23 points at 7,307.00, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
